negative_findings.description: Repeated searches for Finextra and The Paypers articles specifically about Czech Republic bank/payments appointments returned no CZ-specific hits; the outlets' appointment coverage surfaced was for non-CZ companies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Finextra/The Paypers confirmed as live appointment-covering outlets, but no evidence of systematic CZ people coverage. They should be treated as thin, opportunistic feeds rather than reliable CZ trackers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting these two seed outlets in the collection plan; parent-company newsrooms carry the actual CZ signal.

negative_findings.description: SeeNews is scoped to Southeast Europe/Balkans; searches for Czech banking appointments there returned only incidental Czech mentions (e.g. a Slovenian firm's Czech subsidiary).
negative_findings.result_summary: SeeNews is live and has a banking vertical, but Czechia is out of its core geography.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief lists SeeNews as a seed; downgrading it avoids wasted crawl budget.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Czech banking section could be located for emerging-europe.com via search; results redirected to CNBC's unrelated 'Emerging Europe' branded page.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named seed source could not be substantiated; a later pass should fetch emerging-europe.com directly rather than rely on search indexing.

negative_findings.description: The seed query referenced 'PaymentsCVE-type newsletters'; no such outlet or newsletter could be identified in search. It appears to be a placeholder rather than a real publication.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Reuters or Bloomberg CEE/Prague desk landing page for banking people-moves was confirmed in this pass; their CZ appointment coverage appears distributed across general company news rather than a trackable section.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reuters/Bloomberg not recorded as discrete sources; both are also heavily bot-defended and licence-restricted for automated collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should route wire coverage through licensed feeds or mirrors rather than assuming a scrapable desk page.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified, collectable Reuters/Bloomberg pathway for CZ banking leadership news.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate a licensed feed (Reuters Connect, LSEG, Bloomberg terminal export) or use exchange/EQS/GlobeNewswire disclosure mirrors as the substitute primary layer.

coverage_gaps.description: The Wayback/archive capability is identified but no concrete watchlist of CZ leadership URLs to snapshot and diff has been built (csob.cz, csas.cz, kb.cz, rb.cz, moneta.cz, airbank.cz, comgate.cz management pages).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit URL watchlist of CZ bank/PSP 'vedení / představenstvo / management' pages, register them with Save Page Now, and run periodic CDX diffs.

coverage_gaps.description: International English trackers found here skew to banks and their parents; CZ payments-specific actors (Comgate, GoPay, Global Payments CZ, Worldline CEE, Mastercard/Visa CZ country managers) are barely covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add scheme and PSP corporate newsrooms plus LinkedIn/company blog monitoring for CZ country-manager appointments in a dedicated cell.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell's international trackers cover senior leadership moves well but give almost nothing on the 'jobs/hiring' topic (headcount, recruitment volumes, layoffs) for CZ banking.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route jobs/hiring signal to a separate cell using CZ job boards (jobs.cz, LinkedIn Jobs), bank career pages, and Czech labour-market reporting; do not expect it from international aggregators.

coverage_gaps.description: Several of the highest-value English sources for this cell (bne IntelliNews, Central Banking, Euromoney, The Official Board, GlobalData) are subscription-gated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide a budget/licensing line for at least bne IntelliNews; otherwise design collection around headlines-only and free primary disclosure.

brief: For CZ banking/payments people intelligence, the reliable English-language layer is not the trade press but the foreign parents themselves: Erste Group, KBC, Société Générale and RBI announce Czech CEO, management-board and country-head changes in English regulated releases, mirrored on GlobeNewswire, Euronext and EQS — these are free, timestamped, and the earliest record. International aggregators (Finextra, The Paypers, FinTech Futures, IBSi, XPRIMM) do cover appointments but showed no systematic Czech coverage in this pass, while bne IntelliNews is the strongest genuine CEE desk and is paywalled; SeeNews and Emerging Europe did not substantiate as CZ people sources. The archive dimension is the cell's distinctive contribution: CZ bank management pages such as rb.cz's Bank Management are stable diff targets, and a Wayback CDX watchlist over 'vedení / představenstvo' pages would catch the org changes companies never announce. Local-language search was run and produced two useful Czech-side anchors (Kurzy.cz corporate wire and oPojištění.cz's dedicated 'Jmenování a odchody' rubric) for cross-dating what the English trackers aggregate.
